transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because I keep having these thoughts lately. Just catching myself thinking that... maybe it would be easier if I just didn't wake up. I mean, I haven't made any kind of plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But... yeah. That's why I came in.
How long have you been having these thoughts about not waking up?
Um... I don't know exactly. It's been a while, I guess. Maybe... maybe three months? Just kind of a low spell that's been hanging on since... well, since I crashed a while back.
Have you been enjoying the things you usually like to do over the past few months?

Not really, no. I just... I quit caring about the stuff that usually settles me down. Used to like fishing, digging through old vinyl records... tailgating. Even checking on my home-brew. But lately, it all just feels like chores. So I don't bother.
Have you noticed any decrease in pleasure from activities that you normally find enjoyable over the past few months?
Yeah... like I was just saying. I'm not really getting anything out of it. The fishing, the records, my home-brew... I just quit caring about all of it. It just feels like chores now.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep over the past few months?

Yeah... it's been off. Um... even when I do manage to sleep now, I just... I end up waking up way before daylight. Just lying there with my stomach all tight, and... I don't know, my mind's already going on about bills and... stuff I messed up. So, yeah. Not sleeping great.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite over the past few months?
I guess... yeah. Most days lately, I just have to remind myself to eat. Supper just sits there, and... I don't know, it just looks like too much trouble. My jeans are definitely fitting looser.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly or feeling like you're speeding up in your thoughts or actions lately?
No... I don't think so. Um, haven't really paid attention to that. I guess I just move normal. Nothing's really speeding up, anyway. Just... regular.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty about anything lately?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I guess everyone has things they wish went differently, but... I don't really dwell on it. So, no. I wouldn't say that.
Have you felt like you're moving slower than usual lately?
Um... no. Like I just said, I think I'm just moving normal. Not slow or anything. Just regular.
Have you felt like you're resting or sitting still more often than you usually do?
No... I mean, I work retail, so I'm on my feet most of the day anyway. I don't really sit around more than usual. It's just... the same.
Have you felt like you're fidgeting or restless more often than usual lately?
Um... no. Not really. I haven't noticed anything like that. Just... going about my usual routine, I guess. So, no.
Would you say these thoughts of not waking up and your loss of interest in activities are interfering with your daily life a lot or just a little?

I guess... a lot. Things at home just got kind of sloppy. I fell behind on bills... missed some callbacks and appointments. I really needed to keep a steady job search going, but I just couldn't do it. It got to where I knew I couldn't just... handle it by willpower anymore. So yeah. A lot.
Would you say these feelings have been present every day over the past three months?
Yeah... pretty much every day. It's just... this low spell has been hanging on for about three months now. Ever since that crash. So, yeah.
Would you describe your low mood as being consistently severe over the past three months?

Yeah... I guess so. After that... burst of energy I had wore off, it just felt like somebody pulled the plug on me. I'd just sit at the table... staring at my coffee. Just feeling empty... and ashamed, I guess. So, yeah.
Have you experienced little to no pleasure in activities that you would normally find enjoyable for most of the past three months?

Yeah... I guess. I just... I quit caring about the things that usually settle me down. Like, I didn't even want to go fishing... or dig through vinyl records. Even tailgating or... checking on my home-brew just felt like chores. So, yeah. I just didn't care.
Have you felt like you're moving slower or more slowly than other people lately?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that. Just... regular, I guess.
Would you say that your low mood has been present for most of the day, nearly every day, over the past three months?
I... I don't really know about every single day. I don't keep a log of it or anything. It's just... it's been a while, I guess. I couldn't tell you if it's most of the day.
Would you say that your low mood is mild, moderate, or severe most of the time?
I don't really know how to grade it. It's... I wouldn't call it severe, I guess. It's just kind of... there. I don't really think about it in those terms.
Would you say your low mood is more on the mild side or the moderate side most of the time?
Probably mild, I guess. I... I don't really pay that much attention to it.
Would you say there are any times when your low mood feels overwhelming or almost unbearable?
No... not really. I wouldn't use those words. It doesn't get unbearable or anything like that. I just... I go to work and do what I need to do. It's fine.
